name: MOCA Teen Council
what_you_do: Meet twice a month to learn how a museum works. You plan programs for teens, volunteer at family days and run one big teen event.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 at any Jacksonville high school. You do not need to be an artist.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer hours (past members earned 40 or more)
duration: September to April, first and third Wednesday, 5 to 6:30 pm
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 year closed August 24, 2026. Watch the page for the next year.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application when it opens. Required: two Family Day volunteer shifts. Meetings are the first and third Wednesday of each month from 5 to 6:30 pm.
notes: Past members earned upwards of 40 service hours. Members must volunteer at two Family Day events, with dates to be announced.
